$comment: Travel mode: the start and dates sheets, earlier purchases, payments outside the budget, Settings → Travel, one trip's screen and the trip card. `name` is the trip's name (its tag), which is user data.

untitled.note: Shown as a trip's name when its tag no longer exists.

error.running: Travel mode is already on. End the current trip first.

spent.note: Part of the one-line trip summary: "Lisbon · 420 of 900 EUR · day 3 of 7".

day.note: Part of the one-line trip summary.

dayOf.note: Part of the one-line trip summary.

dayPlanned.note: A trip that has outrun its planned last day; date is "22 Sep".

span.note: A past trip; from/to are "3 Jul 2026".

leftToday.note: Next to a big amount on the last day.

perDayLeft.message: a day for the {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left
perDayLeft.note: Next to a big amount: what each remaining day may cost.

outside.note: Payments of the trip chosen to stay out of its budget.

label.note: VoiceOver label of the card's head.

pace.note: Spending per day against the planned pace.

unconverted.note: amounts is a list like "12.00 THB, 5.00 USD".

card.showSpent: Show what it was spent on
card.hideSpent: Hide what it was spent on

categoryLabel.note: VoiceOver; name is a category, trip the trip's name.

start.title: Travel mode

pastTitle.note: Title when recording a trip that already happened.

start.subtitle: Every new expense gets the travel tag; the budget counts everything with it, whatever currency it was paid in.
start.pastSubtitle: Name it and say what it was meant to cost; its purchases come next.

where.note: Placeholder of the trip name when no city is known.

noRateBody.message: Payments from your {home} accounts could not be counted towards a {currency} budget. Keep it in {home} instead?

dates.title: Travel dates
dates.hint: Tap the first day, then the last. It can start today at the latest, and end whenever you like.
dates.hintPast: Tap the first day, then the last.
dates.tapLastCalendar: Tap the last day on the calendar

whatWasName.note: A past trip: which of those days' expenses were the trip.

backfill.hint: Flights, hotels or tickets bought before leaving: tick them and they belong to the trip. You can add the tag to anything later too.
backfill.hintPast: The expenses from those days. Tick the ones that were the trip.
backfill.addTo: Tap to add to the travel
backfill.tick: Tick the ones that belong to it

outside.title: Outside the budget
outside.hint: Tick what the budget was not meant for — the flights booked months ago, say. It is still part of the trip, just not of its budget.

count.note: Number of payments kept outside the budget.

settings.title: Travel

noteShort.message: In travel mode, new expenses get the trip’s tag and count towards its budget.
noteShort.note: Note on the travel mode settings screen; the ⓘ unfolds noteMore.

noteMore.message: In any currency. Trip spending stays out of your monthly budgets.

now.note: Section header above the trip that is running.

settings.startHint: Where, how much, and the dates
settings.addPastHint: A trip that already happened, and what it cost

trip.noRateBody: Connect to the internet once, or keep the budget in its currency.

endBody.message: {line}. New expenses stop getting the “{name}” tag; it stays here as history.

trip.removeBody: Only the travel budget goes. The tag and every transaction with it stay.

currencyHint.message: {currency} · payments in any currency are converted

trip.addPurchasesPast: Pick the ones from those days
trip.outsideHint: Paid for the trip but not from its budget — the flights booked months ago, say. Choose them one by one.
trip.endHint: New expenses stop getting the travel tag
